conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Its low water content and high sugar concentration create an environment where bacteria and other microorganisms cannot thrive. Honey is also naturally acidic, which further inhibits microbial growth.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent

conversation.speaker: ai_agent

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Modern food preservation techniques include dehydration, freeze-drying, and curing, which all reduce water content. Additionally, pasteurization and irradiation are used to eliminate microorganisms and extend shelf life.
